name: 会話内の複数メッセージ選択パネル
prompt:
Edit the first full-screen render to match the native preview’s message bubble width. Keep its correct 390 × 642 near-exact frame, header, dates, Japanese copy, selected-state checks and footer toolbar in the same positions. Change only the three bubble widths and their right edges: at target scale each bubble must start at x=60 and end at x=330 (270 px wide), leaving 60 px of white space on the right. The first render made them about 307 px wide and ended at x=367.

Preserve exact Japanese text and time: 明日は一日空いています。 / みなさんの予定はどうですか？ / 00:32. Keep the text dark, time gray, and selection circles green with white checks. The Japanese native preview shows no linked or underlined text, so do not color any message text blue. Maintain the header 山田 はるか and green キャンセル, pale-mint date pills 昨日 and 今日, and bottom count 4件を選択 with gray action icons.

Use the 390 × 642 Japanese native preview as the authoritative geometry reference. Keep the clean white background, no wallpaper or phone frame, and do not add messages or controls.
reviewNotes: The three selected Japanese messages and footer match, but bubble width is about 237px versus the 270px preview target after two attempts. The Japanese preview has no link text.
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
